name: Workbench neutral technical figures
principles: Choose the form from the question: branches, topology, merge, journey, decision, boundary or sequence.
Use only neutral grays. No accent-colored title bars, gradients, shadows or decorative frames.
Position, arrows, labels and line styles carry meaning; gray intensity never implies a measured quantity.
Remove a figure when a short list or selectable table explains the content better.
Keep labels concise, preserve Chinese/Latin spacing, and inspect both language exports.
Preserve prompts and code as text. Do not invent numeric data to justify a chart.
